questions.question: What is the price for a design project?
questions.answer: The price for a design project depends on the complexity of the project and the number of designs we need to create.

questions.question: Why wouldn't I just hire a full-time designer?
questions.answer: Good question! For starters, the annual cost of a full-time senior-level designer now exceeds $100,000, plus benefits (and good luck finding one available). Aside from that, you may not always have enough work to keep them busy at all times, so you're stuck paying for time you aren't able to utilize.

questions.question: Is there a limit to how many requests I can have?
questions.answer: No, there is no limit to how many requests you can have. You can have as many requests as you want, and we will handle them all one by one.

questions.question: How fast will I receive my designs?
questions.answer: On average, most requests are completed in just two days or less. However, more complex requests can take longer.

questions.question: How do you handle larger requests?
questions.answer: We handle larger requests by breaking them down into smaller, more manageable pieces. We then handle each piece one by one.

questions.question: What if I don't like the design?
questions.answer: No worries! We'll continue to revise the design until you're 100% satisfied.
